name: Expedition archivist
design: Huge robust adult male with squared bronze biomask, four shallow forehead ridges and heavy angular cheek plates, thick short scalp tendrils held by plain brown strap. Rugged green divided coat over full grey utility tunic, silver protective panels and generous brown canvas pouches, reinforced shin plates. Left forearm hugs a large CLOSED metal-bound ledger, right carries a long capped cylindrical document case close to thigh. Rolled weather cover attached to a flat archive backpack.
